segments.sn3.5:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.5:1.3: “idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn3.5:1.4: ‘kesaṃ nu kho rakkhito attā, kesaṃ arakkhito attā’ti?
segments.sn3.5:1.6: ‘ye kho keci kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti;
segments.sn3.5:1.8: Kiñcāpi te hatthikāyo vā rakkheyya, assakāyo vā rakkheyya, rathakāyo vā rakkheyya, pattikāyo vā rakkheyya;
segments.sn3.5:1.11: Bāhirā hesā rakkhā, nesā rakkhā ajjhattikā;
segments.sn3.5:1.13: Ye ca kho keci kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti;
segments.sn3.5:1.15: Kiñcāpi te neva hatthikāyo rakkheyya, na assakāyo rakkheyya, na rathakāyo rakkheyya, na pattikāyo rakkheyya;
segments.sn3.5:1.18: Ajjhattikā hesā rakkhā, nesā rakkhā bāhirā;
segments.sn3.5:2.2: Ye hi keci, mahārāja, kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti … pe … tesaṃ arakkhito attā.
segments.sn3.5:2.5: Bāhirā hesā, mahārāja, rakkhā, nesā rakkhā ajjhattikā;
segments.sn3.5:2.7: Ye ca kho keci, mahārāja, kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti;
segments.sn3.5:2.9: Kiñcāpi te neva hatthikāyo rakkheyya, na assakāyo rakkheyya, na rathakāyo rakkheyya, na pattikāyo rakkheyya;
segments.sn3.5:2.12: Ajjhattikā hesā, mahārāja, rakkhā, nesā rakkhā bāhirā;
segments.sn3.5:3.3: Manasā saṃvaro sādhu, sādhu sabbattha saṃvaro;

lines: Sādhu sabbattha saṃvaroti iminā kammapathabhedaṃ apattassa kammassa saṃvaraṃ dasseti.
